excerpt: Canada Creates a New PR Pathway for Doctors By Anuj Sengar, Licensed RCIC R515178 · Founder, Can X GlobalPublished: February 2026 · 5 min read Canada is approaching a dangerous moment. In 2026, the real risk isn’t too much immigration — it’s getting immigration wrong. A sharp policy over-correction following years of expansion is now creating instability for employers, students, provinces, and investors, just as Canada is approaching a demographic cliff. This risk has been flagged prominently in recent Canadian thought leadership, including joint analysis by RBC and Eurasia Group.
